uart_id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: Manually specify the ID of the UART hub used to connect to the device.

*See also: [VBus Component](https://esphome.io/components/vbus#configuration-variables)*

command.docs:
The `command` corresponding to your device (see below).

*See also: [VBus Component](https://esphome.io/components/vbus#configuration-variables)*

dest.docs:
The `DFA` value corresponding to your device (see below).

*See also: [VBus Component](https://esphome.io/components/vbus#configuration-variables)*

sensors.docs:
A list of [Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor) definitions that include a `lambda` to do the decoding and return a `float` value.

*See also: [VBus Component](https://esphome.io/components/vbus#configuration-variables)*

source.docs:
The address corresponding to `your device model` (see below).

*See also: [VBus Component](https://esphome.io/components/vbus#configuration-variables)*
